_why: Written 2026-08-18, the day this site was brought up to fleet parity from an index.html-only stub. privacy.html makes no_account/no_tracking/no_ads claims about this build; this backs them with evidence from the actual app repo (~/Developer/DrVanus/hoardling3d) rather than removing the claims. Hoardling 3D forked game.js from hoardkeep before the fork diverged (see hoardling3d/README.md), and the Lb/localStorage code cited below is unchanged from that fork point.

evidence: game.js's Lb module header comment (unchanged from the hoardkeep fork point): 'Identity: Supabase NATIVE ANONYMOUS sign-in ... mints a session directly, no relay/captcha.' There is no sign-up form, username field, or password anywhere in index.html or game.js.

game.js tag(): the WICK-XXXX leaderboard name is derived entirely from the anonymous session's own refresh token — 'no input UI' per the function's own comment. The player never types or chooses a name.
No screen in the game (title, level select, Forge, Trials, result) contains a login, password, or profile UI — verified by reading index.html and grepping game.js for form/input elements.

grep across game.js for analytics/tracking SDK markers (gtag, Sentry, Firebase, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Segment, PostHog) returns zero matches — the only third-party network calls in the file are the Supabase leaderboard endpoints under /auth/v1 and /rest/v1, disclosed on this same privacy page.
This build ships no audio system at all (no audio/ folder, no audio fetch calls in game.js), unlike the main Hoardling build — one less network surface than the app this was forked from.
grep across game.js for ad SDK markers (AdMob, admob, ironSource, AppLovin, Unity Ads) returns zero matches.
README.md's own VERDICT (2026-08-14) recommends parking this project rather than investing further — there is no monetization plan or ad surface anywhere in game.js or index.html.

No form or input field anywhere in index.html or game.js asks for a name, email, phone number, or any other personal detail — the only identity in the app is the auto-generated WICK-XXXX leaderboard tag (see no_account evidence).
The leaderboard payload itself is a wave-count integer plus a server-issued token (game.js Lb.flush(), 'p_board'/'p_name'/'p_value'); no personal field is ever constructed or sent.

contract_notes: Hoardling 3D is a parked, experimental fork (see README.md's 2026-08-14 VERDICT: 'Recommendation: park this' — the painted 2D game at hypersage.ai/hoardling/ is what ships). It is still live and playable, so it carries the same submission-blocking legal surface as any deployed product. It shares its hypersage.ai origin with the main Hoardling build, so the anonymous leaderboard session and the sound-mute preference are shared browser-storage state between the two (same-origin localStorage) even though campaign save data (hoardling3d.save.v2 vs hoardling.save.v2) and leaderboard boards (hoardling3d_daily vs hoardling_daily) are kept separate — privacy.html discloses this explicitly. Re-verify this contract if this fork is ever un-parked, merged back into the main build, or given IAP/ads.
